hint: Red, blue, red, blue — it takes turns! After red comes blue.
Two greens, then a yellow — over and over. After two greens comes yellow!
Star, moon, star, moon — it switches each time. After a star comes the moon!
Dog, cat, mouse — then it starts again! After cat comes the mouse.
Two triangles, then a circle. After two triangles comes the circle!
Clap, open, clap, open — it alternates. After a clap comes the open hand!
Apple, apple, banana — over and over. We just had a banana, so next is an apple!
Orange, blue, orange, blue — it takes turns. After blue comes orange!
A sock goes on your foot, so a glove goes on your… hand!
A cow gives us milk, so a hen gives us… an egg!
Day is the opposite of night, so hot is the opposite of… cold!
A bird lives in a nest, so a bee lives in a… hive!
A car drives on a road, so a train rides on… tracks!
A fish swims in water, so a bird flies in the… sky!
We see with our eyes, so we hear with our… ears!
A pencil is for writing, so scissors are for… cutting!
Apple, banana, orange are all FRUITS. A dog is an animal — it doesn't belong!
Car, jeep, bus all drive on the ROAD. A plane flies in the sky — it's different!
Fish, octopus, crab all live in the WATER. A bird lives in the air — it's the odd one!
2, 4, 6 are even — you can count them by 2s. 5 is odd, so it doesn't fit!
A tree, a tulip, a sunflower are all ALIVE and grow. A rock is not alive — it's different!
A bee, butterfly, ladybug all FLY. A fish swims — it's the odd one out!
Carrot, broccoli, corn are VEGETABLES. A strawberry is a fruit — it doesn't belong!

question: I am a number. I am bigger than 5 AND smaller than 7. What number am I?
hint: Bigger than 5 means 6, 7, 8… Smaller than 7 means it can't be 7. Only 6 fits both!

question: I am a number between 8 and 10. What number am I?
hint: Between 8 and 10 means right in the middle — that's 9!

question: I say 'moo' and I give milk. What animal am I?
hint: Only one animal both says 'moo' AND gives milk — the cow!

question: I am yellow, I am a fruit, and monkeys love me. What am I?
hint: Yellow + fruit + monkeys love it — all three point to the banana!

question: Tom is taller than Sam. Sam is taller than Ben. Who is the TALLEST?
hint: Tom is taller than Sam, and Sam is taller than Ben — so Tom is taller than everyone. Tom is tallest!

question: A bag has 3 red balls and 1 blue ball. You grab one without looking. Which color will you PROBABLY get?
hint: There are way more red balls (3) than blue (1), so red is much more likely!

question: I have 4 legs, I say 'woof', and I am a pet. What am I?
hint: 4 legs + says 'woof' + a pet — all the clues point to a dog!

question: Each animal is BIGGER than the last. Which one comes next?
hint: Mouse, cat, dog — getting bigger each time! The biggest one next is the elephant 🐘.

question: What comes FIRST in a butterfly's life?
hint: A butterfly starts as a tiny egg 🥚, then a caterpillar 🐛, then a butterfly 🦋!

question: Morning, then noon… what comes next in the day?
hint: Morning sun rises, the sun is high at noon, then night comes — the moon 🌙!

question: A plant grows bigger. What is the LAST, biggest stage?
hint: A seedling grows into a small plant, then into a big tree 🌳!

question: A person grows up. What comes next?
hint: A baby grows into a kid, and a kid grows into a grown-up 🧑!
